day_shape: 83 items: Iran navy claims another tanker hit a mine east of Hormuz, CENTCOM confirms two IRGC drones shot down over Bahrain, UN Security Council hears competing Gulf-Iran maritime briefings, heavy Khamenei Fatimiyya mourning cycle.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker and mine claims
threads.summary: Iran's navy said an oil tanker caught fire after striking a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz, framed by Defa Press as a 'violating' vessel with tracking off. A separate smuggled-fuel fire was reported in Sirik waters.

threads.label: IRGC Bahrain drones and Qeshm MQ1 claims
threads.summary: CENTCOM confirmed two IRGC one-way attack drones launched at Bahrain were shot down by US forces with no damage, rebutting an IRGC claim of hitting a US early-warning radar. IRGC separately claimed destruction of a seventeenth US MQ1 drone over Qeshm Island.

threads.label: UN Security Council on Gulf maritime security
threads.summary: The Security Council met at Bahrain's request to hear GCC and UN briefings on Gulf maritime threats, with Gulf states blaming Iran and the Houthis and Tehran blaming US and Israeli action. Houthis separately claimed attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid airport and a Saudi oil pipeline pumping station.

threads.label: Khamenei Fatimiyya mourning cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office pushed out a dense cycle of audio and video recordings from the Zaynabiah evening mourning ceremony for the martyrdom of Fatima al-Zahra, held on the Leader's behalf. IRIB and Defa Press carried matching coverage of the ceremony.

threads.label: US posture: pressure over strikes
threads.summary: Rubio said US economic pressure on Iran makes further strikes unnecessary, while Treasury Secretary Bessent said he had moved to a military base over Iranian death threats. Mossad chief Gofman was reported in Washington to push for a return to conflict, and Trump is said to be meeting Xi and Putin in Shenzhen on the Iran war.

threads.label: Iraq pulled between Tehran and Washington
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Iraq's PM secretly visited Iran on 6 November seeking pressure on officials stalling a Hormuz-bypass pipeline, while Iran International said hardliners are pressing Baghdad to resist US-driven border and flight restrictions. Defa Press carried Baghdad's Friday prayer leader attacking US envoy Tom Barrack, and IRIB reported Iraq denied closing its airspace for 72 hours.

threads.label: Iran economic strain and oil output
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iranian oil output fell nearly half from pre-war levels in October per IEA data, cited Kayhan accusing Pezeshkian's government of alarmism as prices rose 89% year-on-year, and described cash-strapped Iranians selling organs. IRIB announced a 100-fold gas tariff for top-tier residential consumers.

At the beginning of this ceremony, which is presided over by His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Javad Haidari, while seeking intercession through the sacred shrine of the Master of the Age, may God hasten his return, recited elegiac poetry in mourning for the Mother of the Righteous, may God's peace and blessings be upon her, and then Hujjat al-Islam.
